## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or
discussion when there is one.

## How it was checked

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. Describe any
relevant checks you could not run.

For a metadata or saving change, a small synthetic regression example helps
show which prompts, resources, image samples, or filenames should result.

## User-facing details

Explain any effect on saved metadata, filenames, image quality, settings,
dependencies, or documentation. Include screenshots when they clarify a UI
change. Review all attachments for private content before posting.
